entities.summary: Emily Martin is an American anthropologist. She is a professor emerita of socio-cultural anthropology at New York University. She received her undergraduate degree from the University of Michigan in 1966 and her PhD from Cornell University in 1971. Before 1984, she published works under the name of Emily Martin Ahern.
